notes.title: Bunker | Update 17.8.25
notes.content:
Fixed bug. Fixed a bug with bolts tightening inside the wall.
Fixed bug. Reduced the impact of a collision that caused the player to freeze in place.

Rework. Added a digital scoreboard for the digital lock.

At the moment, a larger number of rooms and various tasks for them are being developed.

notes.title: Bunker | Update 25.4.25
notes.content:
Fixed bug. The iron locker came off when there was a player in it, which caused it to fall out of the playing area.

Rework. The quality of the text on the tooltips no longer depends on the overall quality of the textures.
Rework. The keys of the digital lock now have their corresponding name, which can be read if you look at them.
Rework. Minor improvements to the code.

notes.title: Bunker | Update 1.4.25
notes.content:
Fixed bug. When opening the lockers, the shader on the lamp did not turn on the glow mode.

Rework. When exit of the game, there was no English translation for the labels.
Rework. Minor improvements to the code.

notes.title: Bunker | Update 30.3.25
notes.content: Fixed bug. Incorrect loading after the death of the game character.

notes.title: The first update
